MOS two-phase Dickson charge pump
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VCLK clk 0 PULSE(0 3.3 100n 1n 1n 499n 1u)
XDUT vdd 0 out clk astra_050_mos_dickson_charge_pump
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec boost range 5.5 7 unit=V
* @spec ripple range 0 0.2 unit=V
* @spec final range 5.5 7 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 5n 200u
meas tran boost AVG v(out) FROM=150u TO=200u
meas tran ripple PP v(out) FROM=150u TO=200u
meas tran final FIND v(out) AT=200u
write out.raw v(out) v(clk) v(xdut.p1) v(xdut.p2)
quit
.endc
.end
